version: R9 holdout protocol, frozen before tuning and holdout execution
objective: Unchanged R8 coupled nonconvex continuous-time control family; no manufactured value or payoff modification

tuning.rule: Minimum mean validation cost across two seeds; ties to smaller multiplier; multiplier applied to each method's native actor/critic learning rate, not SOC adversary rate

run_order: Fixed seed-randomized NBO/SOC order after method-specific warmup; separate setup-plus-training and training-only clocks
initialization: Identical actor and critic initial parameters within each pair; digests asserted equal; independent method training streams with same reset seed
other_comparator: Clipped Riccati feedback for the corresponding quadratic running/terminal problem; evaluated on the unchanged nonquadratic objective without training

audit.deployment: sample-and-hold action; Gaussian transitions and running cost are exact per slab in real arithmetic; 64/128 difference compares two policies, not an Euler-error estimate
audit.arithmetic: float32 policy rollout with float64 summaries; Monte Carlo, not outward-rounded certification

primary_contrast: NBO minus author SOC-MartNet expected realized cost under the declared training-and-audit pipeline
inference: All 12 seed differences, means, median, IQR, descriptive Student interval; one-sided exact sign test and Bonferroni correction over six dimension-budget panels. No general computational-dominance claim; no Gaussian-seed assumption for sign inference.
development_disclosure: Model family and base adapters are inherited from R8; seed599 smoke tests preceded freeze. Original-economy and action-certificate development are not presented as preregistered. Holdout seeds were not used for method selection.
failure_policy: Preserve every run and fail the aggregate on missing/nonfinite output. Never select seeds or budgets after observing outcomes. Any necessary implementation correction must be separately documented.
